thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: Reserved GPU pool 'resv-east-2a' saturated (100% used). high queue growth for reserved-tenants: ['AcmeCorp', 'OrchidBank']. autoscaler failed scale up: quota_limit_reached. paging oncall.
andrea: getting paged in. joining.
paul_oncall: oncall here. can someone drop the immediate customer impact? cs_jess do we have active support tickets?
cs_jess: AcmeCorp reported timeouts for batch jobs ~ 3m ago. They're seeing 429s and stalled queues on our SDK. OrchidBank hasn't opened a ticket yet, but monitoring shows long tail latencies.
eli: quick check: autoscaler tried to provision 8 gpus, cloud returned 403 quota_exceeded. logs: "QuotaExceeded: Requested vGPU count beyond account limit". also saw lots of long-running sessions from a single tenant id (session_id prefix: acme-rt-)
andrea: noted. possible noisy neighbor from Acme. can we identify top sessions by GPU minutes in last 30m?
sre_nick: running query: `SELECT tenant, session_id, gpu_minutes FROM sessions WHERE pool='resv-east-2a' AND started>now()-interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY gpu_minutes DESC LIMIT 10` -> top 1 is tenant AcmeCorp, session acme-rt-9145 consuming 72 GPU-mins, many short-lived retried jobs too.
mira_ops: if Acme has runaway jobs, we can evict or throttle their sessions on resv pool to free up capacity. what's their SLA? do we need coordination with sales/CS?
cs_jess: Acme is enterprise with reserved capacity but not currently under separate eviction protection. they do have a support contact; must notify before evicting, but health > customer impact priority? they already impacted.
paul_oncall: ok escalation decision: immediate mitigation to restore platform availability. plan: 1) isolate and throttle top offending sessions (soft throttle 50%) 2) if not enough, evict oldest retry storms for that tenant 3) request temporary borrow from hosted pool (fallback) 4) escalate quota request with cloud via infra channel.
andrea: executing step1: applying per-tenant token_bucket throttles to AcmeCorp for resv-east-2a. command: `./adminctl throttle --tenant AcmeCorp --pool resv-east-2a --rate 50% --reason "noisy-session mitigation"`
incident-bot: deploy-bot: throttle policy applied to tenant AcmeCorp on resv-east-2a by andrea (change-id c12f8). rolling out.
eli: seeing drop in new GPU allocations from Acme after throttle. queue depth reduced from 860 -> 410 in 2m. GPU utilization still at 96% though.
paul_oncall: good. start step2 if queues don't drop further in 3m. andandrea, can you also mark offending sessions for eviction candidate?
andrea: marking sessions with pattern `acme-rt-*` older than 10m and with >5 retries as eviction candidates. command: `./adminctl mark-evict --tenant AcmeCorp --pattern "acme-rt-*" --min-age 10m --min-retries 5`
mira_ops: I can run controlled eviction on those candidates with safety window 30s between kills to avoid cluster thrash. want me to proceed?
paul_oncall: proceed. but hold if CS requests pause.
cs_jess: I'm drafting a short customer notification now: "We're actively mitigating elevated latency by throttling excessive sessions. We'll notify when your jobs resume normal throughput." Sending to Acme POC now.
cs_jess: sent message to Acme POC, they're on call and acknowledged, asked for immediate logs if they see failures. they said they're running a retry loop on a failed internal dependency.
mira_ops: starting eviction run: seq kill acme-rt-9145 -> acme-rt-9221 -> acme-rt-9003. logs: `evict:session=acme-rt-9145 reason=noisy_retries user=andrea job=evict-1723`
incident-bot: scale-bot: attempted manual scale up to +4 GPUs in resv-east-2a -> cloud returned 403 QuotaExceeded. requested quota via infra channel (ticket INFRA-6578)
eli: while evictions free up some slots, we need fallback in case scale remains blocked. propose routing new reserved-tenancy requests to hosted pool (with encrypted data path) for short window. impact: possible cost bump and latency variance.
andrea: +1 to fallback; config snippet:
```
route_policy {
  match: tenant in ["AcmeCorp", "OrchidBank"]
  action: route_to: hosted-east-1
  ttl: 15m
}
```
paul_oncall: implement fallback, but must set automatic revert after 30m. also enable extra logging.
mira_ops: applying route change now. `./routing apply --file tmp/fallback-acme.json` -> success. new requests from Acme now hitting hosted-east-1.
eli: telemetry shows hosted pool accepting but end-to-end latency increased ~80ms median, cost per token +12%. acceptable for urgent mitigation.
cs_jess: Acme replied: "Thanks, saw throughput return but some timeouts for in-progress jobs. They prefer we resume normal dedicated routing when safe." I'll keep them updated.
andrea: queue depth now 160, GPU util down to 72%. good headroom. evictions freed ~6 GPUs.
paul_oncall: follow-ups: - open incident bridge (I've created zoom link and posted to #incidents) - file cloud quota emergency (INFRA-6578) and ping vendor rep - create post-incident action items: quota increase, per-tenant retry limits, alert tuning - coordinate with CS for customer postmortem
andrea: documenting quick runbook notes: `evict -> throttle -> fallback -> quota-req` in case we need a runbook snippet.
eli: one more: autoscaler failed due to quota but also hit a rate-limit on AMI provisioning; adding AMI warm pool pre-warmed images to reduce future provisioning failure window.
mira_ops: will follow-up with infra to set warm pool config.
incident-bot: pagerduty: incident -> acknowledged by paul_oncall. status: mitigated -> partial; monitoring for 30m.
paul_oncall: marking incident as mitigation in progress. switching offpager to andrea for next 60m.
andrea: taking over. I'll stay on the bridge and coordinate with infra until quota confirmed.
cs_jess: I'll send a concise customer summary and schedule follow-up call with Acme tomorrow.
eli: logs and query snapshots saved to /mnt/incidents/1732109999/snapshots.tar.gz
mira_ops: cleanup tasks: revert routing after ttl, confirm evicted sessions not auto-restarted, and add alert for quota-exhaustion state.
paul_oncall: thanks team. postmortem owner = andrea. set priority P1 and due date 3 days. closing handoff.
andrea: acknowledged, I'll kick off retros and assign actions. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
